Capped by economics rather than feasibility: at a $50.46 AOV, a hand-typed DM conversation buys a small ticket, so it is a supplement to paid rather than a primary channel. Existing warm-outreach claims cover contact inventories and opener structure but not sourcing prospects from your own content's commenters and qualifying them off their profile.
